selection_rationale: A1 is the only architecture that provides CONTINUOUS retention while maintaining CONTINUOUS drainage. All valve-based approaches (A3, A4, A5) require interrupting drainage, creating safety risk. A2 (affinity) is viable but harder to manufacture. A1 exploits the eShunt lumen geometry uniquely — the permanent transvenous shunt creates a fixed-diameter passage where a size-selective membrane can be integrated.
final_rationale: A1 (Size-Selective Filtration) survives initial 102/103 analysis. No single reference discloses all 6 limitations. CereVasc has delivery (L1+L6) but NOT retention+drainage (L2+L3+L4). EnClear has drainage (L3+L4) but NOT retention (L2) or eShunt config (L6). The combination of size-selective membrane + continuous drainage + eShunt anatomy is novel. HOWEVER, this is LLM-assessed, NOT passage-grounded. Full passage-level audit against all relevant prior art families is required before calling STRONG.
